[
  {
    "operation": "etymology",
    "chain": "Mandalay < Burmese မန္တလေး (Mantalay); possibly from Pali mandala (circle) + le (river); via Sanskrit mandala = sacred circle",
    "reading": "Sacred circle of the river — a bounded, ritual space where sound and center meet.",
    "languages": ["my", "pi", "sa", "en"],
    "source": "OED, entry 'Mandalay' (etymology)",
    "confidence": 0.6
  },
  {
    "operation": "phonetic_split",
    "chain": "Man + da + lay; man (en) = human; da (fr) = given; lay (en) = song/ballad; also 'man' (fr) = hand",
    "reading": "The hand that lays down the human song — a sung foundation, a manual of melody.",
    "languages": ["en", "fr"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.5
  },
  {
    "operation": "cross_language_homophone",
    "chain": "Mandalay ~ mandala (sa) + lait (fr) = milk; mandala + lait → 'milk of the circle'",
    "reading": "Nourishing circle — the white, lacteal essence of a sacred diagram.",
    "languages": ["sa", "fr", "en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.4
  },
  {
    "operation": "anagram",
    "chain": "Mandalay → 'day' + 'lam' + 'an'; lam (ar) = to gather; day (en) = light; an (en) = indefinite article",
    "reading": "A day of gathering light — the indefinite dawn of collected rays.",
    "languages": ["en", "ar"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.3
  },
  {
    "operation": "notariqon",
    "chain": "M-A-N-D-A-L-A-Y → M(ateria) A(nima) N(umen) D(ivinum) A(eternum) L(ux) A(eterna) Y(ggdrasil)",
    "reading": "Matter, soul, divine spirit, eternal light, world-tree — a cosmic ladder in one word.",
    "languages": ["la", "en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.2
  },
  {
    "operation": "letter_symbol",
    "chain": "M = water (hebrew mem), A = ox/head (aleph), N = fish (nun), D = door (dalet), L = ox-goad (lamed), Y = hand (yod)",
    "reading": "Water, ox, fish, door, goad, hand — a sequence of primal tools and thresholds.",
    "languages": ["he", "en"],
    "source": "Sefer Yetzirah (letter correspondences)",
    "confidence": 0.5
  },
  {
    "operation": "numerical",
    "chain": "M=40, A=1, N=50, D=4, A=1, L=30, A=1, Y=10 (Hebrew gematria) → 40+1+50+4+1+30+1+10 = 137",
    "reading": "137 — the fine-structure constant, the number of electromagnetic coupling and cosmic order.",
    "languages": ["he", "en"],
    "source": "generative (gematria calculation)",
    "confidence": 0.4
  },
  {
    "operation": "phonetic_split",
    "chain": "Man + dal + ay; dal (he) = door; ay (fr) = has; 'man' (en) = human; 'dal' (ar) = shade",
    "reading": "The human door has shade — a threshold that both admits and protects.",
    "languages": ["en", "he", "fr", "ar"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.3
  }
]
